name: coding-chops
description: Open-source visual curriculum for System Design, DSA, and Problem Solving

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run validate:curriculum
scripts.render:brand: for c in Brand-Avatar-YouTube Brand-Avatar-Instagram Brand-Avatar-Facebook Brand-Avatar-X Brand-Banner-YouTube Brand-Banner-X Brand-Banner-Facebook; do remotion still src/index.ts $c out/brand/$c.png; done
scripts.render:ps01-packaging: remotion still src/index.ts PS01-Thumbnail out/ps01-thumbnail.png && remotion still src/index.ts PS01-Social-Cover out/ps01-social-cover.png && remotion still src/index.ts PS01-Social-Cover-Part-01 out/ps01-social-cover-part-01.png --gl=angle && remotion still src/index.ts PS01-Social-Cover-Part-02 out/ps01-social-cover-part-02.png && remotion still src/index.ts PS01-Social-Cover-Part-03 out/ps01-social-cover-part-03.png --gl=swiftshader && remotion still src/index.ts PS01-Social-Cover-Part-04 out/ps01-social-cover-part-04.png
scripts.render:reel: remotion render src/index.ts VR01-Database-Index out/vertical/vr01-database-index.mp4 && remotion still src/index.ts VR01-Cover out/vertical/vr01-cover.png
scripts.render:reel-03: remotion render src/index.ts VR03-Rate-Limiting out/vertical/vr03-rate-limiting.mp4 && remotion still src/index.ts VR03-Cover out/vertical/vr03-cover.png
scripts.render:reel-04: remotion render src/index.ts VR04-Quicksort out/vertical/vr04-quicksort.mp4 && remotion still src/index.ts VR04-Cover out/vertical/vr04-cover.png
scripts.render:reel-08: remotion render src/index.ts VR08-Big-O-Cheat-Sheet out/vertical/vr08-big-o-cheat-sheet.mp4 && remotion still src/index.ts VR08-Cover out/vertical/vr08-big-o-cheat-sheet-cover.png
scripts.render:reel-09: remotion render src/index.ts VR09-Sorting-Race out/vertical/vr09-sorting-race.mp4 && remotion still src/index.ts VR09-Cover out/vertical/vr09-sorting-race-cover.png
scripts.render:hanoi-reel: remotion render src/index.ts VR02-Tower-Of-Hanoi out/vertical/vr02-tower-of-hanoi.mp4 && remotion still src/index.ts VR02-Cover out/vertical/vr02-cover.png
